offers_products.reason: Manufactures latches, hinges, mirrors, mirror-cameras, returnable packaging and blow mold tools through Big 3, Eberhard and Velvac.

offers_services.reason: Engineering and program management support custom hardware sales; the main offerings are manufactured products, not standalone services.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells to OEMs, manufacturers and truck aftermarket channels; no direct household buyers among main customers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Customers are vehicle, aircraft and truck OEMs, manufacturers and aftermarket distributors buying hardware and packaging.

recurring_revenue.reason: Components and hardware are supplied through repeat OEM production orders and aftermarket parts, though without subscriptions.

cyclical_demand.reason: Demand follows truck, vehicle and industrial production; OEMs cut orders in downturns, and blow mold tools are capital purchases.

big_ticket.reason: Latches, hinges, mirrors and packaging are small, frequent component purchases, though custom mold tools are larger.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes from manufactured hardware, mirrors and packaging; engineering support is secondary to the products.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are large OEMs in trucks, vehicles, aircraft and durable goods, plus large packaging and pharma producers.

asset_heavy.reason: It is a light-to-moderate manufacturer of small components. It needs plants but isn't heavy industry like utilities or rail.

notes: Asset intensity is a judgment call for a mid-sized manufacturer.
